```yaml
name: Sync Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Remove submodule entry
        run: |
          git rm -f .gitmodules
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git commit -m "Remove submodule entry" || true

      - name: Clone Open WebUI as shallow copy
        run: |
          rm -rf open-webui
          git clone --depth 1 --no-tags https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui
          rm -rf open-webui/.git

      - name: Update .gitignore
        run: |
          echo "open-webui/" >> .gitignore

      - name: Update documentation
        run: |
          echo "# Open WebUI Integration" >> docs/open-webui.md
          echo "" >> docs/open-webui.md
          echo "This repository includes a synced copy of Open WebUI for development purposes." >> docs/open-webui.md
          echo "" >> docs/open-webui.md
          echo "## Automated Sync" >> docs/open-webui.md
          echo "Open WebUI is automatically synchronized weekly via GitHub Actions." >> docs/open-webui.md

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Sync Open WebUI" || true

      - name: Push changes
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
